notes.title: The "KUUKIYOMI" Series: "8 YOUs+" Release Announced & "Jump,YOU!+" Out Now!
notes.content:
The mini-game 8 YOUs in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It gets an upgrade!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38651015/526234e6b092f89566132213656f98fe9c30469f.jpg
You are trapped on a train that runs forever. 
What's worse, the train is filled with countless versions of YOU, all looking exactly like YOU... 
Pay close attention and find the one different YOU among the eight, then make your way to the last car and reach the exit!

This is an enhanced version of the 8 YOUs mini-game included in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It. It now supports multiplayer and features score rankings, offering even more exciting gameplay.

What's New in "8 YOUs+"?


 "Two Player" Mode!

You can race alongside another player to compete for the fastest escape!


 Score Rankings!

Score rankings are now available for each stage.
Challenge '8 YOUs' players from around the world based on your scores!



 Collection!

There are 88 different versions of YOU. 
You can add the successfully identified YOU to your 'Collection' with the criticize action!



 New Stages!

There are 3 stages in total.
Under certain conditions, 2 additional stages will unlock...!


The Steam version of 8 YOUs+ is set to launch on March 13th.
Be sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready to play!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399580


The Steam version of Jump,YOU!+ is now available!
To celebrate the release, we're holding a 20% off sale for a limited time.
Don't miss this opportunity to grab it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399590

notes.title: The "KUUKIYOMI" Series: "Jump,YOU!+" Release Announced & "YOU Game+" Out Now!
notes.content:
The mini-game Jump YOU in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It gets an upgrade!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38651015/fcbe763351679923a053f80cf5c769aa09d54e87.jpg
As a lost stray cat, you tirelessly jump toward the top to return to your owner!

This is an enhanced version of the Jump YOU mini-game included in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It. It now supports multiplayer and features score rankings, offering even more exciting gameplay.

What's New in "Jump,YOU!+"?


 "Two Player" Mode!

The two of you, connected by a rope, will work together to reach the top.
If one of you slips, the other can pull them back up!
Team up with friends or family and climb together as a pair!


 Score Rankings!

Compete with players worldwide to achieve the highest score in each game mode.
Try to top the leaderboard in both the "One Player" and "Two Player" rankings!


 New Stage!

The stage layout from the middle stages onward in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It's "Jump YOU" has been partially revamped!
Even if you’ve cleared the previous game, challenge yourself with the new stages!



The Steam version of Jump,YOU!+ is set to launch on February 27th.
Be sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready to play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399590

The Steam version of YOU Game+ is now available!
To celebrate the release, we're holding a 20% off sale for a limited time.
Don't miss this opportunity to grab it!

notes.title: Series Spin-off "YOU Game+" Release Confirmed!
notes.content:
The YOU Game from KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It is back, now with a "+" (plus) for even more fun!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37023485/c7c39e7cb32f9152f491a0a87ae8cedb456fdb2c.jpg
Let’s combine "YOU" and "YOU" to create a BIG "YOU"!

This is an enhanced version of the YOU Game mini-game included in KUUKIYOMI 4: Consider It. It now supports multiplayer and features score rankings, offering even more exciting gameplay.

What's New in "YOU Game+"?


 "Two Player" Mode!

In this mode, you and a friend take turns dropping "YOU"s into the same box.
Work together to get the highest score possible!


 Score Rankings!

Compete with players worldwide to achieve the highest score in each game mode.
Try to top the leaderboard in both the "One Player" and "Two Player" rankings!


 Skin System!

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock skins that change the appearance of "YOU".
Three different skins are included, and you’ll have to play to find out what skins are available and how to unlock them!



The Steam version of YOU Game+ is set to launch on February 13th.
Be sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready to play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399570/
